sections.title: The AMC 10 at a glance
facts: $25$ questions in $75$ minutes: about $3$ minutes each.
Right: $6$ points. Blank: $1.5$ points. Wrong: $0$ points.
All blank scores $25 \times 1.5 = 37.5$; a perfect paper scores $150$.
Score $= 6R + 1.5B$, where $R$ is right answers and $B$ is blanks.

sections.title: To guess or to leave it blank
facts: A random guess among $5$ choices is worth $\frac{1}{5} \times 6 = 1.2$ points on average: less than a blank's $1.5$.
Rule out $2$ choices and a guess among $3$ is worth $\frac{1}{3} \times 6 = 2$ points: more than a blank.
Rule out $1$ choice and a guess among $4$ is worth $1.5$: the same as a blank.

sections.title: Pacing
facts: Questions $1$–$10$ are usually quickest: aim to bank them in about $20$ minutes.
The 2-minute rule: stuck for $2$ minutes with no plan? Mark it, skip it, come back.
Leave $5$ minutes at the end to check the questions you flagged.

sections.title: Read it twice, draw it
facts: Read the last line twice: watch for "how many more", "not", "at least", "in total" and "including".
$n$ posts in a row make $n - 1$ gaps; $k$ cuts make $k + 1$ pieces.
Counting from $a$ to $b$ with both ends included gives $b - a + 1$ numbers.
Draw walks on a grid and lines with every point marked: overlapping lengths count twice.

sections.title: Work backwards
facts: Start from the end and undo each step, last step first.
Undo adding by subtracting, multiplying by dividing, squaring by a square root.
Check by running your answer forwards through the steps.

sections.title: Using the answer choices
facts: Plug a choice back into the problem: start with (C), the middle value, then go up or down.
Check the choices' units digits, parity or size to rule some out quickly.

sections.title: Estimate and eliminate
facts: Round the numbers first: choices far from your estimate are out.
Only last digits affect the last digit of a sum or product.
An odd sum of two whole numbers means one is even, so their product is even.
Compare powers by giving them matching exponents: $2^{40} = 16^{10}$ and $3^{30} = 27^{10}$.
